subtasks.description: Declare all registers (text_in_r, sa, dcnt, kb, kcnt, ld_r, text_out) and internal combinational wires (state, go, sa_ark, sa_next, sbox_out, mixcol_out, output_map, shift_out, round_key_sel, kb_ld, etc.) as per S003 and S004. Ensure port declarations match the interface in S003 exactly.
constraints: Do not add new top-level ports or registers beyond those defined in S003 and S004.

subtasks.description: Instantiate one aes_key_expand_128 (u_ke) and sixteen aes_inv_sbox (us00 through us33) with connections as described in S005. Connect key expansion ports (clk, kld, key, wo_0-3) and wire each state byte to the appropriate sbox a input and substituted b output.
constraints: Exactly 16 aes_inv_sbox instances named us00 through us33.
Do not alter instance naming conventions.

subtasks.description: Implement purely combinational inverse round transformations: InvShiftRows (cyclic right shifts per row), AddRoundKey (XOR with round_key_sel selected from kb[dcnt]), InvMixColumns (GF(2^8) matrix multiply using pmul_e/b/d/9, bypassed when final_round is active), and final output mapping in column-major order. Utilize sbox outputs from B2 for InvSubBytes.
constraints: All logic must be combinational; no sequential elements inside this block.
InvMixColumns must be fully bypassed when the final_round control flag (from B4) is asserted.
Use pmul_e, pmul_b, pmul_d, pmul_9 helper functions for GF multiplications.

subtasks.description: Implement the explicit FSM with states IDLE, KeyLoad, KeyExpansion, KeyStored, InitialRound, StandardRound, FinalRound, Done as per S008. Manage round counter (dcnt) and key buffer counter (kcnt) as described in S009 and S012. Handle data loading (S010), key buffer writes, and final output capture (S013). All register updates (text_in_r, sa, kb, kcnt, dcnt, ld_r, text_out) occur on rising clock edge with synchronous reset.
constraints: All sequential updates synchronous to clk; active-high synchronous reset.
FSM transitions must follow the state diagram in S008 exactly.
Define priority for simultaneous kld/ld at IDLE (e.g., kld) and ensure done asserted only in Done state and held until next load or reset.
